[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Noran Vran''' was a young [[Gender/Legends|female]] officer in the [[656th regiment]], which served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in [[Xanas City]]. After [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] death at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], she was in need of medical supplies for her troops. She made a deal with [[Magresh (criminal)|Magresh]], who had actually stolen the supplies from her facility in [[West County]], in exchange for ten portable missile launchers. However, the missile launchers were rigged, and after Vran left they exploded, killing Magresh.
